name: Shutdown or stoppage the employer causes
authority: 民法 §487 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=B0000001&flno=487): the employer’s delay in accepting the work leaves the wage owed; the day is not an absence.

name: Stop-work ordered by the labour inspection authority
authority: 職業安全衛生法 §36(2) (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0060001&flno=36): 勞工於停工期間應由雇主照給工資.

name: Work stopped by a typhoon or other natural disaster
authority: 天然災害發生事業單位勞工出勤管理及工資給付要點 (https://laws.mol.gov.tw/FLAW/FLAWDAT01.aspx?id=FL049468): not an absence and the attendance bonus untouched; the day’s wage may be withheld (the suspension’s facts.withhold_wage).

name: Lawful strike
authority: 勞資爭議處理法 §54 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0020007&flno=54); 民法 §482: no work, no wage for the strike days; not attended.

name: 減班休息 agreed in writing to reduce hours
authority: 因應景氣影響勞雇雙方協商減少工時應行注意事項 (https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/12438/post): days off unpaid, a monthly-paid full-time worker’s month never below the minimum wage; insurance and pension kept.
